page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6.13xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via a KVM hypervisor. It features 52 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. System memory totals 96.0 GB, providing an allocation of approximately 1.85 GB of RAM per dedicated vCPU.

This instance configuration includes no bundled local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring persistent block storage attached over the network. Networking capability is backed by a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps. The server does not contain dedicated hardware acceleration GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its high core-to-memory ratio, ecs.c6.13xlarge offers cost efficiency for compute-intensive workloads that require substantial CPU processing capacity without requiring large amounts of memory per vCPU. The instance is suited for tasks such as batch processing, high-performance computing, video encoding, software compilation, and web serving clusters.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6.13xlarge is a compute-optimized instance running on KVM virtualization and the x86_64 CPU architecture. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor clocked at 2.5 GHz, it supplies 52 dedicated vCPUs alongside 96.0 GB of total system memory. This hardware ratio yields approximately 1.85 GB of RAM per virtual vCPU core. The instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Local storage is not included in the instance specification, requiring external block storage for data persistence, nor are dedicated GPUs present. The high concentration of vCPUs relative to memory provides favorable cost efficiency for compute-heavy applications that do not require extensive memory footprints per core. Recommended deployment scenarios include distributed software compilation, batch compute processing, video encoding pipelines, and scalable web server deployments.
